The beauty of the thinkers art lies in the fact that one has no idea the provenance or providence of thoughts, nor their rhyme or reason, and yet thought itself dares to wonder at its own truth and identity. Impossible though it is, thought thinks to know itself. But as thinking is made of thought, and thoughts make for thinking, nothing of thought is ever finally known. Never finally known, thought never really begins to know at all.
